question: Find the ratio in which pulses at ₹80 per kg can be mixed with pulses at ₹95 per kg to get a mixture worth ₹85 per kg.
solution:
Given:

Pulses of rates Rs.80 per kg and Rs.95 per kg are mixed together to get pulse worth Rs.85 per kg.

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88a344c757b68c1f8e6341e580776bf4adff7ebcb3ef7164a2e31f43575e6c75.png] 

Ratio of 1st kind and 2nd kind in mixture = (N - T) : (T - M)

**Calculations:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d07d2ca78f614b3fd4a644f00cd6af2330947ec841800dc9968b501e6c0be36.png] 

So, the ratio of 1st kind of pulse to 2nd kind in mixture

⇒ 10 : 5 = 2 : 1

**∴ The Required ratio is 2 : 1.**
